script_text: Uranus shatters Aquarius' Air-filled stability with a harsh square to the 6th House. Monday brings Saturn square Uranus at 11 degrees Capricorn, disrupting your 2nd House finances and shattering your 4th House foundation. Tuesday delivers a trine between Mars and Uranus in the 8th House, sparking health transformations. Mid-week, Uranus' trine with Jupiter sparks a profound shift at the 10th House cusp Thursday, unlocking emotional wisdom. Thursday brings Uranus entering the 9th House, expanding your worldview and bringing spiritual insights. The weekend fuels the Sun's alignment with Mars at 10 degrees Aries, giving you the strength to take bold action on your 2nd House projects. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters the 5th House. Friday is your worst day as Pluto squares Venus in the 11th House. Set boundaries with your 11th House friends to avoid the Uranus-Pluto tension. Follow for daily updates.
